findings.quote: A latency figure with no filter attached does not map onto an index query shape.
A rollback in week 48 has no other route back to a working console.
An index that no one has rebuilt from empty is a rumour about the database rather than a copy of it.
A rollback plan that is first read on the night of the cutover is a description of the damage rather than a remedy.
The spillway holds every mutation the index writer rejected, and the replay job drains it every 15 minutes.
The weathervane reports which store answered each console request, and the regional dashboard groups its output by hour.
